purpose: The (field x angle) grid the field-review resident reads. Every cell is one literature-led question about THIS plant.

angles.question: a RECENT result (2023-2026) in this area — what is new right now, from a source that still exists
angles.read: the primary source itself, not a summary of it

angles.question: a foundational idea we may have MISread or applied too loosely here
angles.read: the primary text, and this plant's own text, side by side

angles.question: a known CRITIQUE or failure mode of this area that our practice would reproduce if we adopted it blindly
angles.read: the critique's own argument, including what it concedes

angles.question: a CROSS-DOMAIN transfer of this area onto one of this plant's parts
angles.read: the source mechanism, then the named file in this repository it would change

angles.question: an OPERATIONAL mechanism this area proposes — something implementable, not just a philosophy
angles.read: the mechanism's definition and its stated limits

angles.question: a concrete METRIC or experiment this area uses to measure itself
angles.read: the metric's definition, and what it would measure in this plant
